fresh-clone verifier import bootstrap and truthful CLI

repair_scope.flip_specificity_policy: Reproduce the frozen implementation after code/preregistration comparison. If any new mismatch is found, do not repair it on this branch and return INCONCLUSIVE_BITPROBE_STAGE0A_R0A_INFERENCE_REPAIR.

original_binding.preservation: byte-identical tree required before and after repair

additional_allowed_inputs: committed edge inventory and source binding

chronological_half_bootstrap_contract.split_rule: first=sequence[:floor(N/2)], second=sequence[floor(N/2):] on the original frozen chronological sequence
chronological_half_bootstrap_contract.resampling: independently sample contiguous blocks within each already-split half for flip first, flip second, no-flip first, and no-flip second
chronological_half_bootstrap_contract.last_block_rule: append complete sampled source blocks in draw order and truncate only the final appended block at the target resample length
chronological_half_bootstrap_contract.dataset_replicate_rule: one replicate computes every eligible PRN first/second kernel once and emits exactly one dataset-level median; exactly 500 medians per dataset
repaired_outputs: reproducibility coherence bootstrap 95 percent lower bound
between-PRN same-minus-different bootstrap 95 percent lower bound

exact_prn_permutation_contract.prn_identity_usage: label permutation only; never a feature

must_not_change: same/different medians and same-minus-different point estimate
may_change: directly dependent gates and substantive verdict

checks: code/config binding and input access audit
bootstrap half isolation and exact permutation shape
repaired metric reproduction and final verdict
manifest, zero post-result method/gate change, zero forbidden access
